# Obesity library proposals

Use this folder for proposed library membership changes and durable decision notes.

**Rule:** After the Phase 0 library architecture is accepted, do not edit canonical membership silently. Propose first.

## Proposal template

```markdown
# Proposal: [ADD | REMOVE | REPLACE] [Source ID or short title]

**Date:**  
**Proposer:**  
**Affects version:** v0.1 → proposed v0.2

## Recommendation
Add / Remove / Replace ___

## Why this earns (or loses) a seat
- Role it would serve
- What unique material it covers
- What existing source already covers (or fails to cover) the same ground

## Impact if accepted
- Domains affected
- Boundaries or controversies affected
- Sources displaced (if replace)

## Decision
Pending / Accepted / Rejected
```

## Active proposals / decision notes
